notes: Rob Citrone is the Founder of Discovery Capital Management, a $2 billion global hedge fund investing across equities, fixed income, currencies, and rates with a focus on emerging markets. Rob is one of the longest standing managers in the space and the largest investor in his fund. He trained under Julian Robertson in the heyday of Tiger Management in the mid-90s before launching Discovery in 1999. Since then, the firm grew to a peak of $15 billion in assets and despite the subsequent reduction in AUM, he and his team of 42 are still going strong. Our conversation dives into Rob's background, lessons he learned from Fidelity, Julian Robertson, and George Soros, and the launch of Discovery. We discuss his investment strategy, research process, perspective on markets around the world, ups and downs in the business, and managing an organization through change. Rob doesn't often share his insights in the public forum, so it was a real treat to get inside the mind of one of the best in the business.  Rob Citrone is the Founder of Discovery Capital Management, a
$2 billion global hedge fund investing across equities, fixed
income, currencies, and rates with a focus on emerging markets. Rob
is one of the longest standing managers in the space and the
largest investor in his fund. He trained under Julian Robertson in
the heyday of Tiger Management in the mid-90s before launching
Discovery in 1999. Since then, the firm grew to a peak of $15
billion in assets and despite the subsequent reduction in AUM, he
and his team of 42 are still going strong.

Our conversation dives into Rob’s background, lessons he learned
from Fidelity, Julian Robertson, and George Soros, and the launch
of Discovery. We discuss his investment strategy, research process,
perspective on markets around the world, ups and downs in the
business, and managing an organization through change.

Rob doesn’t often share his insights in the public forum, so it was
a real treat to get inside the mind of one of the best in the
business.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
